GOVINDA RATHI
Derivatives Trader | Equity & Derivatives Dealer | Market Analysis
◻ +91-8007131513 • ✉govindarathi737@gmail.com • ◻ Malad, Mumbai • linkedin.com/in/govinda-rathi
PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY
Dynamic finance professional with 2+ years of hands-on experience in derivatives execution, order management, 
and real-time market operations in India’s index derivatives market. Managed client accounts by handling order 
placement, trade execution, and portfolio updates — providing responsive, client-first service and building trust 
through clear communication and timely execution. Proven expertise in executing high-value trades across NIFTY 
and SENSEX, managing proprietary capital of ₹2 Crore, and operating under pressure in fast-moving markets. Now 
seeking to leverage deep market knowledge and execution skills in a client-facing Equity Dealer or Retail Dealer 
role, where I can combine technical expertise with strong relationship-building to deliver best-in-class order 
execution for clients.
KEY SKILLS & COMPETENCIES
Execution: Equity & Derivatives Order Execution, Multi-leg Options Strategies, Terminal Operations (BSE/NSE) 
Market Knowledge: Index Derivatives (NIFTY/SENSEX), Option Greeks, IV Analysis, Open Interest, Market 
Microstructure
Strategies: Calendar, Diagonal, Butterfly Spreads, Straddles, Delta-Neutral, Pair Trading, Arbitrage
Client Skills: Client Relationship Management, Order Execution for Clients, Interpersonal Communication, 
Stakeholder Coordination, Trade Reporting
Risk & Compliance: Real-time Risk Monitoring, Drawdown Control, SEBI Regulatory Framework, NISM Certified
Tools & Analysis: Technical Analysis, Fundamental Analysis, Algo Strategy Execution, Volatility Analytics
WORK EXPERIENCE
RM – Dealing | Religare Broking Limited | Mumbai
May 2026 – Present
	• Executing equity and derivatives orders for retail clients across NSE and BSE platforms.
	• Assisting clients with trade execution, margin-related queries, and portfolio updates.
	• Providing market updates and supporting clients in managing their trading positions.
	• Ensuring compliance with internal risk controls and regulatory guidelines.

Derivatives Trader | Jainam Broking Ltd | Mumbai
Dec 2025 – March 2026
	• Managing and deploying ₹2 Crore proprietary margin across index derivative strategies on live trading 
terminals.
	• Executing complex multi-leg options strategies including Calendar, Diagonal, Butterfly Spreads, and Straddles 
with precision timing.
	• Structuring Delta-Neutral and Gamma-High portfolios based on real-time volatility outlook and market 
conditions.
	• Coordinating with internal stakeholders (risk desk, back-office, compliance) on trade confirmations and 
settlements — building foundation for client-facing communication.
	• Conducting live volatility analysis using IV Rank, IV Percentile, and skew interpretation to inform execution 
decisions.
	• Managing real-time portfolio risk using Option Greeks (Delta, Gamma, Theta, Vega, Rho) and enforcing strict 
drawdown controls.
	• Executing statistical pair trading and arbitrage strategies between NIFTY and SENSEX across exchanges.

Derivatives Trader | Mansukh Securities & Finance Ltd | Mumbai
Apr 2024 – Nov 2025
	• Managed client accounts by handling order placement, trade execution, and portfolio updates across equity and 
derivatives segments.
	• Executed algorithmic and discretionary trading strategies in index futures and options, including Calendar, 
Diagonal, and Butterfly spreads.
	• Monitored market volatility, option Greeks, and trade performance to support execution and risk management 
decisions.
	• Conducted market research and analysis of macroeconomic factors, identifying trading and arbitrage


mailto:govindarathi737@gmail.com

	opportunities in index derivatives.

Finance Intern | Motilal Oswal Financial Services Ltd | Mumbai
Apr 2023 – Jul 2023
	• Performed Fundamental and Technical Analysis of various stocks in the Indian financial market.
	• Gained early exposure to broking operations and client-facing financial services environment.

EDUCATION
Master in Management Studies (MMS) — 2024
Thakur Institute of Management Studies and Research, Mumbai University
Bachelor of Commerce (B.Com) — 2020
Sant Gadge Baba Amravati University, Amravati, Maharashtra
CERTIFICATIONS & LICENSES
	• NISM Series VIII – Equity & Derivatives | NSE | SEBI Certified

Date of Birth: 11 January 2000 | Languages: English, Hindi, Marathi


	PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY
	KEY SKILLS & COMPETENCIES
	WORK EXPERIENCE
	EDUCATION
	Master in Management Studies (MMS) — 2024
	Bachelor of Commerce (B.Com) — 2020

	CERTIFICATIONS & LICENSES
